query:
SELECT m.timeSlot, m.attendeeId, m.id as meetingId, s.companyName
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId = '8196151'
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
